scene.bubble: I made a treasure game in the club garden! Follow the map: ten steps, two turns… and don't step on the tomatoes!
scene.intro: Erik made a treasure game in the club garden! Follow the map: go straight for ten steps, turn left at the tree, cross the little bridge and turn right at the flowers. Mateo turns left when the map says right and ends up in the neighbour's garden — twice. The treasure is a box of biscuits. Give directions to your friend: can they find the treasure?

data.voice_note: Voces: Erik (leyendo el mapa) y Mateo (buscador oficial).
data.script: Erik: Treasure game, player one: Mateo! Start at the garden door. … Erik: Take twelve steps towards the apple tree. … Mateo: One, two, three… twelve! Now what? … Erik: Turn left at the water barrel. … Erik: Cross the little wooden bridge — don't fall in the pond! … Mateo: Crossed it! I can see the vegetable garden. … Erik: Careful with the tomatoes! Now three steps right… and dig next to the sunflower. … Mateo: A box! Inside… chocolate coins! Best treasure ever! … Erik: And a new map for player two!
